title: Meal Planning for Prediabetes
subtitle: Evidence-based meal planning considerations related to meal planning for prediabetes.
evidence_strength: Established evidence for carbohydrate quality, fiber intake, and weight management; emerging evidence for meal timing and intermittent fasting in prediabetes; moderate evidence for integrating physical activity with diet; limitations due to individual variability and need for personalized approaches.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
